entities.name: Victorino Márquez Bustillos
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Victorino Márquez Bustillos, was a Venezuelan lawyer and politician, and was provisional president of Venezuela from 1914 to 1922. Although Bustillos was elected by Congress, General Juan Vicente Gómez remained the real power behind the presidency. Victorino Márquez died in Caracas on 10 January 1941, aged 82.
